name: fx-structured-comprehensive-validation-reports
instr:
Give Fx callers an explicit way to inspect every independently discoverable application graph defect in one deterministic dry run. Reports must preserve enough structured identity and causal information for tooling to locate, classify, and inspect each failure without running user constructors or invocations or mutating population targets. Existing construction and validation paths must remain behaviorally compatible unless comprehensive reporting is explicitly requested.

Comprehensive validation continues across independent Provide, Supply, Invoke, Populate, Decorate, and Replace defects while preserving each operation's callable, reflected-type, annotation, and output identity. Every diagnostic records its operation, complete module path, caller provenance, subject, explanatory message, and reachable underlying cause when one exists. Diagnostics follow stable option registration and module traversal order, regardless of map iteration, and a successful validation still returns an inspectable empty report. Graph probing applies the same parent, child, sibling, and Private visibility rules as application construction. A report error is nil exactly when no diagnostics exist; otherwise it combines all retained causes so errors.Is and errors.As can reach each applicable cause. ValidateApp and VisualizeError retain their established observations, while ordinary fx.New preserves eager invocation, App.Err, logger initialization, and lifecycle boundaries. Nested Options, annotations
